sections.heading: Full-Service Commercial Door Repair for Chevy Chase Properties
sections.body: Commercial glass doors take a beating in busy environments. Foot traffic, delivery carts, weather exposure, and routine wear all contribute to cracked glass panels, bent frames, misaligned door closers, and broken hardware. Our technicians are experienced with the full range of commercial door systems found throughout Chevy Chase — from aluminum storefront doors and all-glass entryways to heavy-duty framed units common in office and mixed-use buildings. We service automatic door mechanisms, pivot hinges, panic hardware, floor springs, and overhead closers. Rather than replacing an entire door assembly when only one component has failed, we assess each job individually to recommend the most practical and cost-effective solution. Property managers throughout the Chevy Chase area trust us because we show up on time, communicate clearly about the scope of work, and complete repairs to a professional standard that holds up over time.

sections.heading: Storefront and Entryway Glass Replacement in Chevy Chase

We replace single-lite and multi-lite storefront glass, full-length sidelites, transom panels, and all-glass door systems throughout Chevy Chase. Whether your building sits along East-West Highway near the Maryland-DC border or on a quieter side street in one of Chevy Chase's established commercial corridors, we bring the same quality of workmanship to every job.

sections.heading: Door Hardware, Closers, and Frame Repair for Commercial Buildings
sections.body: Glass is only one part of a functioning commercial door system. Faulty closers cause doors to swing too fast or fail to latch properly. Worn hinges allow doors to sag and drag against thresholds. Damaged aluminum or steel frames compromise the seal and structural integrity of the entire assembly. Our technicians diagnose and repair or replace door closers, surface-mounted and concealed hinges, threshold plates, weatherstripping, push-pull hardware, and locking mechanisms across a wide range of commercial door brands and configurations. We also repair and re-square bent or bowed door frames that result from impact damage or gradual foundation movement — a common issue in older commercial buildings throughout Chevy Chase and the broader DC Metro area. Addressing these components together ensures the door operates correctly, closes securely, and stands up to continued daily use.
